About Us

Practical access, personal support.

Elevate Access Solutions provides practical, personalized accessibility and assistive technology solutions for individuals and organizations. We help people identify, learn, and use technology in ways that support confidence, independence, inclusion, and everyday access.

Purpose and practice

Our mission

Our mission is to help people use accessible technology with greater confidence and independence. We focus on practical access, inclusive participation, and solutions that support real needs in daily life, education, and work.

Our approach

Our services are individualized, goal based, and practical. Recommendations are informed by professional knowledge and lived experience, with attention to the person, task, workplace, educational setting, or daily environment where the technology will actually be used.

Who we serve

Support shaped around the people and organizations using it.

Individuals

Individuals who are blind or have low vision.

Families and caregivers

Families and caregivers seeking clearer options and everyday strategies.

Schools and education

Schools and educational organizations supporting accessible learning.

Rehabilitation agencies

Agencies serving people with blindness, low vision, or technology-access needs.

Employers

Employers and organizations improving accessible workplace technology.

Professionals

Professionals seeking more accessible workflows and workplace tools.

Why Elevate Access Solutions

Grounded in real environments.

  • Personalized recommendations.
  • Practical, goal-based training.
  • Experience with assistive technology and accessibility.
  • Solutions intended for real-world environments.
  • A combination of professional expertise and lived experience.
